first_pass_before_proposals.author: codex-ai-model-pilot
notes: 17 elongated bright or red vessel-like objects in the full fondeo image, pending exact zone membership and enlarged inspection.
Very small point near417,734 and partial image-edge feature near894,829 need context; not counted.
Harbor/berths require enlargement; no whole-zone absence conclusion.
No detection tables, proposal counts, geometry or scores queried for Jan18.

coordinate_convention: Native pixel edges [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], half-open; fondeo grid EPSG32615 affine [10,0,734720,0,-10,1541120]. Boxes localize vessel signals with about 1 pixel boundary uncertainty; no physical dimensions inferred. WGS84 precision reflects transformation, not subpixel annotation accuracy.
method: Viewed all 4 raw RGB previews, the full 4 quadrants of fondeo and a detailed harbor crop before proposals.
Recorded 17 open-water vessel centers, then inspected individual enlarged raw crops and fixed pixel-edge boxes before reading detection records.
Intersected only catalog zone geometry and measured valid/observable masks; all in-zone pixels are valid and observable.
Excluded uncertain berth strips and a very small isolated signal; source masks unchanged.
Independent visual objects are not yet classified as accepted detections or additions: parent must match and adjudicate without creating duplicates.
No training, model inference, DB review writes or claim of accuracy.
After the raw reference was hash-locked, queried proposal IDs and geometry only; scores were neither queried nor used. Fourteen matches were unambiguous and one-to-one.

Kept the previously noticed tiny signal U02 indeterminate. Expanded only its unknown training area to encompass the automatic box plus a 10 m margin, because the exporter rejects unresolved proposals overlapping reviewed scope. This post-proposal coverage reduction is explicit.
